item.text: {"summary":"A flowering plant native to mainland Portugal, mountain parsley has a wider European distribution but in Portugal occurs only in the highlands of northeastern Trás-os-Montes, along woodland edges and in clearings. In the 2016–2019 mainland Portugal assessment, it was considered Vulnerable, with only three known locations and a small occupied area, although its national population was then regarded as stable.","humanEdibility":"unknown","edibilityNote":null,"evidence":{"summary":["s1:p1","s1:p4","s1:p5","s2:p1"],"humanEdibility":[]}}
